_what_this_is: Pre-tune measurements for the polish pass. Every number here is a BEFORE value: what the build does today, so a later change can be judged against it rather than against memory.
_authority: Docs/canon/FEEL.md. The windows below are owned by that file; this file only records measurements against them.
_status: SEEDED EMPTY. No value in this file has been measured. Null means not measured, and the gate reports MISSING -- not PASS -- until a human fills it in.
_how_to_measure_traversal: 1. Open Content/HomeWorld/Maps/VS_MVP/L_VS_MVP_Markers.umap in the DESKTOP editor. Cells must be streamed; a nullrhi commandlet cannot time a walk.
2. Use the eight-verb script in Docs/qa/POLISH_HUMAN_PLAYTEST.json as the run order, so the timings come from a comparable route each time.
3. cabin_to_lookout_s: spawn at the cabin PlayerStart, walk the CRUMB_ path to CRUMB_Lookout, stop the timer on arrival. Three runs; record the median.
4. island_circuit_s: cabin -> lookout -> path stones -> back to cabin, the same loop the canon window describes.
5. Write the median to measured_s. Do not record a number you did not time.
_how_to_measure_tunables: Each tunable below currently has no measured value. Record the value the build uses TODAY, before any tuning.
Read the live value out of the editor or log -- do not copy the proposed range out of FEEL.md. The proposal is the destination, not the baseline.
Record strings for enum-ish choices, numbers for numeric ones. A null here is an open question, and leaving it null is a valid, honest answer.

cabin_to_lookout_s.note: Median of three timed walks. Empty until a human times it.

island_circuit_s.note: Full circuit. Empty until a human times it.

_tunable_notes.glide_gravity_scale: FEEL.md proposes 0.35-0.55x default gravity while on the FALLBACK spline. Read the live value from HomeWorldFallbackGlideComponent.
_tunable_notes.glide_lateral_influence: FEEL.md proposes 0 if FALLBACK is cinematic, else <=15% of corridor width. Canon says FALLBACK = no free steer, so the expected reading may well be 0.
_tunable_notes.camera_arm_length_uu: FEEL.md proposes 350-500 UU. Read from the SpringArm on BP_HomeWorldCharacter.
_tunable_notes.camera_pitch_bias_deg: FEEL.md proposes -8 to -15 degrees. Read from the controller or the SpringArm relative rotation.
_tunable_notes.night_length_s: FEEL.md proposes 90-180 s real time before the rest prompt. See Docs/DAYNIGHT_BIBLE.md.
_tunable_notes.gather_cooldown_s: FEEL.md proposes until dawn OR 60-120 s, matching the SYS 'deplete until dawn' preference. Record which branch is actually implemented.

_waiver_policy: Do not write a number here to make a gate go green. A null that is honestly null is worth more than a plausible value, because a plausible value cannot be told apart from a real one later.
